setlist.title: Beat It On Down The Line

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Feel Like A Stranger** (2 reviews): Jerry wails on Feel Like A Stranger, serving as a fun set-closer; The Stranger is unbelievable, with no other version coming remotely close to it [20][22]
- **Morning Dew** (2 reviews): Listener calls this one of the best Morning Dews in over 500 shows; Reviewer loves the Morning Dew and rates the show four stars for that jam [11][17]
- **Bird Song** (1 review): Bird Song, Stranger, and Morning Dew are singled out as standouts of the show [14]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Phil is on fire on Eyes, and Brent’s harmonies are flawless throughout [19]

## The recordings

- **gd1987-03-02.149861.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496** (recommended): soundboard; 20 songs; 156 min; rated 3/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd1987-03-02.150140.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [2]
- **gd1987-03-02.149862.ultra.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 20 songs; 158 min [4]
- **gd1987-03-02.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.82728.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 145 min; rated 4/5 by 8 [5]. Said about its sound: Soundboard quality is excellent, with a CM upgrade noted by the listener [19]

## Around the show

- Jerry forgot words on Althea, but Phil played awesome bass on the version [12]
- Bobby was too loud after Althea, but the band was just getting started [13]
- DSO, featuring new guitarist Stu Allen, made the night shine in comparison [14]
- Reviewer prefers this soundboard version to the matrix recording of the same show [16]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1987-03-02.149861.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 11, 2020; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X90) [1]
- **gd1987-03-02.150140.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 11, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [2]
- **gd1987-03-02.149862.ultra.sbd.pearson-healy.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering By Charlie Miller  May 11, 2020; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-R90) [4]
- **gd1987-03-02.sbd.walker-scotton.miller.82728.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Cassette Master (Sony D5) [5]. Also: Tape flip occurred towards the end of Eyes Of the World [5]
